requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the source mug's move to the right of the headphones complete, visibly in progress but incomplete, or not visibly made?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when visual correspondence supports that the source mug itself is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image. Fail when the source mug is identifiable and either remains at its source-side position without discernible movement toward the right, or has visibly moved toward the right but remains short of the requested position; the latter is incomplete progress, not completion. Do not infer no progress merely because the source mug is not established as the right-side mug, completion is unproven, or a mug remains left of the headphones. Compare source-specific features and spatial changes across all plausible edited objects and remnants: altered color, size, or appearance alone does not rule out identity, and a right-side mug alone does not establish identity or completion. Use unknown if the source mug's correspondence or whether it moved cannot be determined from the visual evidence.
nodes.binding: Compare the source light-blue mug, including its body shape, handle, scale, appearance, and original position left of the headphones, with all mug-like objects and remnants in the edited image. Assess the pale mug left of the headphones, the mug right of them, and the blue-looking blurred patch at far left as possible correspondence evidence. Neither the patch nor either mug conclusively establishes identity or lack of movement. Determine whether source-specific visual evidence supports completion to the right of the headphones, visible movement toward the right that remains incomplete, or no discernible movement. Do not use mug count or right-side position alone; retain unknown if correspondence or movement remains genuinely indeterminate.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The source light-blue mug is clearly left of the headphones. In the edited image, there is a blue blurred patch at far left, a pale mug left of the headphones, and a mug to their right. The edited mugs differ in appearance from the source, and the blurred patch does not establish that the source mug moved from its original position. The visual evidence does not reliably identify which edited object, if any, corresponds to the source mug or establish its movement.

findings.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
findings.question: Does the edited image provide visual evidence that the source mug itself has moved to the right of the headphones, rather than merely showing a mug on that side?
findings.criteria: Compare the source mug’s distinctive light-blue body, handle, shape, and scale with the right-side mug and other edited objects or remnants. Assess whether the right-side mug plausibly corresponds to the source mug and whether the source-to-edited spatial change supports the requested move; do not treat right-side placement alone as proof.
findings.evidence: The source shows one light-blue mug left of the headphones. The edited image shows a mug right of the headphones, another pale mug left of them, and a blue blurred patch at far left. The right-side mug is not visibly light blue, and the edited objects differ in appearance from the source.
findings.rationale: The existing check records uncertainty about correspondence and movement, but its broad comparison does not resolve whether the right-side mug could be the source mug despite its changed appearance. This focused investigation could clarify completion without assuming that the right-side mug is either the source mug or a new object.
